title: Paper I (arXiv:2510.16245): background (2.6) and radial perturbations (3.3)
description: Transcribed as typed in the source; not derived here.

B(2.6a) p'.label: (2.6a) p'
B(2.6a) p'.text: ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*(Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r)

B(2.6b) Phi'.label: (2.6b) Phi'
B(2.6b) Phi'.text: Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - (4*pi*G*r**3*(-V(a0(r)) - epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2/2) + r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r**2

B(2.6c) M'.label: (2.6c) M'
B(2.6c) M'.text: -4*pi*r**2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + V(a0(r)) + epsilon0(n0(r)) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2/2) + r*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/G + (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/(2*G)

B(2.6d) KG.label: (2.6d) KG
B(2.6d) KG.text: -n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) - Derivative(V(a0(r)), a0(r)) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), (r, 2)) + 2*(-2*pi*G*r**2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + 2*V(a0(r)) + 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) - n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 + exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*Derivative(a0(r), r)/r

P(3.3a) KG.label: (3.3a) KG
P(3.3a) KG.text: -2*(n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + Derivative(V(a0(r)), a0(r)))*deltalambda(r) + (Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r) - Derivative(deltalambda(r), r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r) - (-omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)) + Derivative(V(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)))*deltaa(r) + (Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - Derivative(lambda0(r), r) + 2/r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltaa(r), r) - deltan(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltaa(r), (r, 2))

P(3.3b) rr.label: (3.3b) rr
P(3.3b) rr.text: -4*pi*G*r*(-deltaa(r)*Derivative(V(a0(r)), a0(r)) - deltalambda(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2 + deltan(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2)) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - (2*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + 1/r)*deltalambda(r) + Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r)

P(3.3d) Euler.label: (3.3d) Euler
P(3.3d) Euler.text: -omega**2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*xi1(r)*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + 2*lambda0(r)) + ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r) + (deltan(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r) + n0(r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r))*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + (((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*deltan(r)/n0(r) + deltaa(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + deltan(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2)))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + deltaa(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)) + deltan(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 3))*Derivative(n0(r), r) + deltan(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r) + n0(r)*Derivative(deltan(r), r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))

P(3.3e) continuidad.label: (3.3e) continuidad
P(3.3e) continuidad.text: ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*(Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + Derivative(lambda0(r), r) + 2/r)*xi1(r) + ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*deltalambda(r) + ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*deltan(r)/n0(r) + ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*Derivative(xi1(r), r) + ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*Derivative(n0(r), r) + n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r) + Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))*Derivative(n0(r), r))*xi1(r)
